title: circular-gh-ifc-ai: Grasshopper workflow for LLM-assisted IFC data enrichment to support circular reuse of large-panel building systems
description:
Supplementary material for: Płoszaj-Mazurek, M., & Tofiluk, A. (2026). A workflow for LLM-assisted IFC data enrichment to support circular reuse of large-panel building systems in Poland. Journal of Building Engineering, 120, 115397. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2026.115397

Contains the proof-of-concept Grasshopper definition and example BIM/IFC models: IFC parsing via Geometry Gym, data-completeness checking, two-stage attribute enrichment (deterministic lookup tables followed by LLM inference), element-level circularity scoring, colour-coded 3D visualisation, and CSV/JSON export.

This is an experimental demonstrator, not a validated or industry-ready assessment tool. The circularity indicator is provisional, LLM-inferred attributes were checked by expert review rather than against ground-truth data, and no error ranges or sensitivity analysis were computed. Outputs must not be used as a basis for structural, safety, or certification decisions.

Code and Grasshopper definition licensed MIT; example models and documentation licensed CC BY 4.0.
